text:
julia: Quick heads-up — I'm running a dry-run lockfile bump against release/v2.3.0 now. A few submodules showed unpinned refs yesterday so want to catch them before cutoff.
ben: Thanks — what's the plan if a submodule needs a vendor update? Do we hold the merge queue? :thinking: 
julia: Yes, plan is: dry-run -> fix submodule refs -> open small PRs -> hold merge queue for 30m while we land sequentially.
sam: I can take the merge hold. I'll flip the queue to 'hold' when CI for the dry-run passes.
sofia: Can you post the dry-run CI link when it's up? I'll run the smoke vendor tests and quick perf checks. :eyes: 
julia: CI kicked off: deploy-bot: build/lock-dryrun #482 started (results expected ~15m). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/482
jen: Reminder: changelog entries — if any dep bumps change behaviour, add a short note under "dependency updates" section. We want to avoid last-minute surprises in release notes.
ben: Noted. Also please run `git submodule status --recursive` and paste any lines that start with a+ or - so we can triage quickly.
sofia: Quick snippet I ran locally:
```
$ git submodule status --recursive | grep -E "^[+-]" || true
- 3f2c1b4 externals/fasttext (remotes/origin/HEAD)
+ 7b8e9a1 externals/optimizer (new commit)
```
sofia: That fasttext ref is the one that will need a vendor bump. I'll open a PR against release/v2.3.0 and tag it with `deps/lockfile-bump`.
sam: OK when deploy-bot reports green I'll set merge queue hold and assign reviews to @ben and @julia for the submodule PRs.
ben: I'll prioritize reviews. If any vendor CI fails, let's revert and create a rollback PR template so release window isn't blocked.
julia: Good call. Also setting a final cutoff reminder — if we don't have all lock PRs merged by 16:00 UTC today, we postpone lockfile bump to the post-release patch cycle.
jen: I'll post that cutoff in the release calendar and ping sales/legal channel if anything customer-impacting changes.
deploy-bot: build/lock-dryrun #482 passed (steps: submodule-check, vendor-smoke, unit). Artifacts: s3://ci-artifacts/482/lock-dryrun.tar.gz :white_check_mark:
sofia: Dry-run artifacts uploaded. I'll open the vendor PR and reference the CI artifacts.
sam: Putting merge queue on hold now. Holding tag: release/v2.3.0-lock-bump (30m).
ben: Reviewing the PRs now. If everything's green I'll merge and then sam can release the hold. :shipit: 
julia: Thanks all — will follow up in 30m with final status.
